intro_zh: 本課將學習用 by + 交通工具表示搭乘方式，走路則說 on foot。透過鎮裡的生活情境，練習說出去學校、去商店或旅行的交通方式。同時也會看到不同的車輛，如公共汽車、火車和船隻，了解它們在日常生活中的角色。
can_do: 能用 by + 交通工具說出去學校或去其他地方的方式
能用 on foot 描述走路去某地的情況
能在簡單對話中說出自己常用的交通工具及其目的地

sentences.en: Lily lives in a quiet town near the old bridge.
sentences.zh: 莉莉住在老橋附近的安靜小鎮。

sentences.en: She rides her bike to school every day, enjoying the fresh air for health.
sentences.zh: 她每天騎腳踏車去上學，享受新鮮空氣來保持健康。

sentences.en: On rainy mornings she takes the train, but she walks on foot when the sun shines.
sentences.zh: 雨天早上她會搭火車，但太陽出來時她會步行。

sentences.en: After school, she goes to the public library to read about medicine.
sentences.zh: 放學後，她去公共圖書館閱讀有關藥物的書。

sentences.en: Inside the library, she finds a book about America and the wide world.
sentences.zh: 在圖書館裡，她找到一本關於美國和廣闊世界的書。

sentences.en: She dreams of traveling by ship to China to study life there.
sentences.zh: 她夢想坐船去中國，在那裡研究生活。

sentences.en: One summer, she will take a boat across the lake to visit her grandparents.
sentences.zh: 有一天夏天，她將乘小船過湖去看望祖父母。

sentences.en: On her way, she sees a truck, a taxi, and a motorcycle stuck in heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 在路上，她看到卡車、計程車和重型機車被堵在塞車中。

sentences.en: She also likes to ride her scooter over the bridge when the weather is nice.
sentences.zh: 她也喜歡在天氣好時騎輕型機車過橋。

sentences.en: At the weekend, she visits the department store and buys snacks at the convenient store.
sentences.zh: 週末，她會去百貨公司，並在便利商店買零食。

grammar_points.title_zh: ① by + 交通工具，中間不加冠詞
grammar_points.explain_zh: 說明怎麼去某個地方時，用 by + 交通工具。交通工具前面不可以加 a、an 或 the。例如：by bus（坐公車）、by train（坐火車）、by taxi（坐計程車）。特別注意：走路要用 on foot，不用 by。
table: I go to the department store by bus.
He goes to school by bike.
They go to the island by boat.
My father goes to work by motorcycle.
I go to the convenient store on foot.

grammar_points.title_zh: ② take a bus 與 by bus 的差別
grammar_points.explain_zh: "take a bus" 和 "by bus" 都表示「坐公車」，但用法不同。"take a bus" 用動詞 take，後面要加冠詞 a。"by bus" 是介系詞用法，中間不加冠詞。兩種都正確，但在「怎麼去」的句子裡，用 by 更常見。

examples.en: I take a bus to school every day.
examples.zh: 我每天坐一班公車上學。（強調坐上哪一班公車）

examples.en: I go to school by bus every day.
examples.zh: 我每天搭公車上學。（說明交通方式）

examples.en: She takes a train to Taipei.
She travels to Taipei by train.
examples.zh: 她用火車去台北。（強調方式）

examples.en: Do you take a taxi to the hospital?
Do you go to the hospital by taxi?
examples.zh: 你怎麼去醫院？（你搭計程車去醫院嗎？）

dialogue.title_zh: 情境對話：朋友問我怎麼去公園

lines.en: How do you go to the park?
I go to the park by bike.
That's healthy! How about your sister?
She goes by bus. It's more convenient.
Of course! Let's go by bike together.
lines.zh: 當然可以！我們一起騎腳踏車去。

sentences.en: My grandmother lives in the country. She goes to town by truck.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶住在鄉下。她坐卡車去鎮上。

sentences.en: The bridge is very long. People cross it by motorcycle.
sentences.zh: 這座橋很長。人們騎重型機車過橋。

sentences.en: To have good health, I go to the convenient store on foot.
sentences.zh: 為了健康，我走路去便利商店。

sentences.en: The children travel around the world by ship.
In America, many people go to the department store by car.
sentences.zh: 在美國，很多人開車去百貨公司。

sentences.en: My uncle lives in China. He takes the train to work by train.
sentences.zh: 我叔叔住在中國。他搭火車去工作。

sentences.en: The traffic in the city is busy. It's better to go by bike.
sentences.zh: 城市的交通很擁擠。騎腳踏車比較好。

sentences.en: When I have medicine to deliver, I go by scooter.
sentences.zh: 當我要送藥時，我騎輕型機車去。

grammar: 說怎麼去用 by + 交通工具（中間不加冠詞），走路是 on foot。

mcq.q: I go to school ___ bus. (用巴士去學校)
She goes to work ___ bicycle. (使用腳踏車去上班)
He goes to school ___ taxi. (他計程車去學校)

opts: She goes to work by taxi.
She goes to work with taxi.
She goes to work in taxi.
She goes to work on taxi.
mcq.ans: She goes to work by taxi.

fill.q: ____ health is important for everyone.（公共衛生對每個人很重要）
Life ____ medicine are important.（生命和醫藥都很重要）
We ____ the world by ship.（我們坐船看世界）
The ____ is very busy today.（今天交通非常繁忙）
____ and motorcycle are two kinds of bikes.（腳踏車和機車是兩種腳踏車類交通工具）

translate.ans: We see the world by ship.
